CRLR No.695 of 2025
With
(Stay Appl. No.01 of 2025)
(Delay Condonation Appl. No.02 of 2025)
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Pankaj Kumar Sharma, learned 
counsel for the Revisionist.
2. Heard on delay condonation application.
3. There is delay of 666 days in filing the 
instant revision. The main ground as stated by 
learned counsel for the revisionist is that the 
parties had come into the terms of compromise 
and had been living together; second ground is 
that the revisionist was falsely implicated in a 
POCSO matter whereby he could not look up 
for his rights and statement, so made, have been 
documented and is part of the record. 
3. After hearing learned counsel for the 
parties, the grounds are sufficient to condone the 
delay. The delay is condoned. Accordingly, 
delay condonation application is allowed. 
4. Admit.
5. Issue notice to the respondents.
6. Steps to be taken within one week. 
7. Let the objection be filed by the 
respondents within two weeks.
8. List on 18.12.2025.
9. As an interim measure, till the next date of 
listing effect and operation of impugned ex-parte 
judgment and order dated 18.09.2023 passed by 
learned Judge Family Court, Haridwar in Misc. 
Criminal Case No.325 of 2018 Devika Sharma 
vs. Sohil Sharma and entire proceedings of 
Misc. Case No.185 of 2024 pending before 
learned Judge, Family Court, Haridwar shall 
remain stayed subject to the condition that  revisionist shall deposit 30% of the said arrears 
amount of the impugned recovery within two 
months. In default stipulation the interim order 
shall stand vacated. 
10. Stay application stands disposed of. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 16.10.2025
